CPU includes each recognizer and its JavaScript wrapper; model startup is excluded. Silence tests bypass the capture silence gate.
Paced first saved Whisper text and first provisional Zipformer text have different finalization semantics.
Only derived scoring was recalculated from stored recognizer outputs; inference was not rerun. Original results.json is unchanged.
Absolute temporary model paths were made relative in this repository copy. Original outputs remain in the local benchmark workspace.
